text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm Nishino Flower. From here on, I'll be 
making my debut in the Twinkle Series 
together with Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I skipped a grade to come to Tracen 
Academy. Even though I've had my growth 
spurt, my age and body are still young... 
To be honest, I'm anxious about whether I 
can really run properly.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“But Trainer, I have you by my side! 
Because you're always giving it your all 
for me, I'm going to do my very best too!”
